items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: Rick Stepman was hiring guys at a certain point.

ctx.x: Well in that video I thought he was staring at you because for some reason you were set up right in his line of sight and I wondered what that was like. Because you were soloing.

Well a lot of times you would rely on me for certain things. If I’m soloing he could tell when I’m going to finish. And also if you look at anytime you see if you can see my wrist, this wrist here, I always had a wrist watch that had the head of the watch turned backwards so that Buddy — Buddy would come off and he would say to me, “How long have we been up here?” And I would always just look like this. Because if I looked like this it would look like we were checking the time. So I just looked at my wrist and I…
Did he prefer the electric bass?
